attempts.cause: The loyalty_api.add_purchase function incorrectly retrieves the existing points balance instead of calculating and returning the new balance after the purchase.
The points_rules.points_for function is incorrectly implemented, calculating points as floor(amount / 10) instead of 1 point per full 100 spent (floor(amount / 100)).

The loyalty_api.add_purchase function is not correctly returning the points earned, but rather the total points after the purchase, and the tests expect only the points earned for that specific purchase, or the test setup is flawed regarding initial points.
